name: remediate-agent
title: Hostile-Environment Agent Onboarding & Remediation Workflow
description: 3-phase Antigravity dynamic workflow (parallel_triage, staged_remediation, independent_verification) for onboarding and remediating coding agents under simultaneous malware, corrupted configuration/SQLite state, and degraded or offline networks using local Gemma 4 / LiteRT-LM / Ollama.

agents.description: Target agent harnesses to triage, remediate, and verify.

profile.description: Remediation deployment profile (canonical, failsafe, or local-gemma).

local_model.description: Local Google Gemma / LiteRT-LM / Ollama model identifier for offline or local-gemma profile.

offline.description: Enforce airgapped/loopback-only remediation with zero external network calls.

quiesce.description: Terminate rogue non-ancestor target agent processes discovered in /proc.

resume.description: Resume an interrupted remediation run from remediation-journal.json.

from_backup.description: Optional path to a verified offline git .bundle for Stage 0 SoT recovery.

project_dir.description: Optional project workspace directory for repository audit and .agents/ exclusions.
